result.planSummary: Aligned Story 4 package publication around same-project membership plus bounded current package-building context, added automatic package-context seeding from published snapshots on reopen, and refreshed coverage so mixed-producer publish/review/export plus reopened pinned-version reuse are exercised end to end.

changedFiles.reason: Updated the in-memory package publication path to validate same-project members against current refs or already-pinned package-context versions, and taught package-context upsert to auto-seed from a published snapshot on reopen.
Reworked durable package snapshot publication to allow mixed-producer members only when they belong to the same project and are valid in the publishing process’s current package-building context.
Added durable reopen seeding so a current package context can automatically hydrate its pinned members from a published package snapshot.
Expanded package snapshot tests for mixed-producer success, cross-project rejection, and bounded-context rejection.
Added package-context durability coverage for ordered upsert/read behavior, duplicate cleanup, clear behavior, reopen auto-seeding, and republishing an earlier pinned version after reopen.
Adjusted package review fixtures and assertions so mixed-producer package members remain reviewable with pinned provenance.
Adjusted export fixtures so mixed-producer packages still export pinned contents successfully.
Seeded current refs in package-publication integration paths so the stricter Story 4 publication eligibility rule is exercised correctly.

gatesRun.command: corepack pnpm exec vitest run convex/processPackageContexts.test.ts convex/packageSnapshots.test.ts tests/integration/review-workspace.test.ts tests/service/server/package-review-api.test.ts tests/service/server/review-export-api.test.ts --environment node

findingsFixed: Removed the outdated same-process package publication restriction from both durable and in-memory publication paths.
Added automatic reopen seeding so a current package context can inherit pinned members directly from a published snapshot when no explicit members are supplied.
Added regression coverage for mixed-producer package publication, review, export, reopen seeding, and reopened pinned-version reuse.
Fixed the integration fixture omissions exposed by the stricter publish rule by seeding the publishing process’s current refs where publication is expected to succeed.
findingsSurfaced: `test:e2e` in the Epic gate is still scaffold-only repo-wide, so the deepest automated evidence for this story remains integration coverage rather than executable browser e2e.

specDeviations: Package-context seeding and publish-eligibility enforcement remain implemented in existing Convex/store seams rather than a dedicated `package-context.service.ts`, because the current repo still has no browser-facing package-authoring or reopen flow to wire through that service.
result.recommendedNextStep: Hand off to verification, with special attention on the documented service-layer deviation and the repo-wide e2e scaffold limitation; the Story gate and Epic gate are both green.
